name: Professor Alibakhsh Kasaeian
bio: Alibakhsh Kasaeian is a Full Professor at the University of Tehran and Head of the KASA Lab, with over 300 scientific publications, more than 13,000 citations, and an h-index of 67. He has been recognized among the world's top 1% and 2% of scientists for seven consecutive years, holds 18 patents, and has authored 10 books. With 25 years of academic and industrial experience, he has held several senior managerial positions and served on the editorial boards of three WoS-indexed journals. His international achievements include six years of research collaboration with NTUT in Taiwan, delivering six training workshops there, conducting a workshop in Kuwait in collaboration with MIT, and completing a research project for the Swiss company SMTEAM. He has also been recognized as the Faculty's Outstanding Researcher and at the University of Tehran's International Festival.

name: Nastaran Zirak
bio: Nastaran is an Energy Systems Engineer with an M.Sc. in Energy Systems Engineering - Energy Technologies from the University of Tehran. Her research interests include renewable energy systems, solar energy applications, energy efficiency, and data-driven approaches to energy modeling and forecasting. Her work combines experimental investigations with computational methods, driven by an interest in developing sustainable and intelligent energy solutions.

name: Mohammad Ghaziasgar
bio:
Mohammad is a Ph.D researcher at IMT Atlantique (GEPEA–OSE laboratory, Nantes, France), where his work sits at the intersection of mathematical optimization, machine learning, and energy systems engineering. His doctoral research develops machine-learning guided methods for automatically selecting decomposition strategies for large-scale, multi-carrier energy-hub optimization problems — mixed-integer nonlinear programs that are otherwise intractable to solve directly at scale.  
Within KASA Lab, he contributes to research and computational-modelling activities bridging numerical optimization, simulation, and data-driven engineering.

name: Kambiz Divsalar
bio: Kambiz is a M.Sc. researcher with a strong academic background in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and energy systems. His research interests focus on thermal management, fundamental nature of transport phenomena, and energy technologies. His research experience includes developing numerical battery models to accurately predict heat generation during charging and discharging, as well as investigating bio-inspired fin structures and phase change materials to enhance heat transfer and improve battery thermal regulation.
